messages:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a short rolling reboot of the apac-edge GPU pool (az-apac-west1) tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Cohorts of 8-10 nodes, staggered ~6m apart. Expect brief capacity dips; burst backfill enabled.
Julian: +1. Any tenant throttles planned? want to avoid cold-kv spikes.
Sasha: Yes — we'll throttle enqueued inference queues to 50% during each cohort, then ramp back over 5m. KV-cache preheat after each cohort.
Maya: Can you paste the drain commands? I'll run smoke tests after every cohort.
Sasha: Use this for cordon+drain:
```bash
./infractl cordon --pool apac-edge --cohort-size 8
./infractl drain --grace 600 --evict-tasks
```
Ron: I'll tail autoscaler and attach a latency monitor. Ping me if any tail-p95 > 200ms.
Lia: opsbot, create a temporary alert for token-level latency > 250ms and suppress noise.
opsbot: @channel Temporary alert created: token_latency_apac_edge > 250ms (window=5m). Notifying #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket ID INF-4721 created; ETA start=2026-03-23T02:00:00Z end=2026-03-23T04:00:00Z.
Sasha: We'll allow spot-backfill from dedicated pools if available; backfill policy cap set to 12% of pool capacity.
Julian: Cost check — how will we cap spending if backfill kicks in?
Sasha: Backfill will auto-retract if estimated cost delta > $400/hr or error rate rises. Also rolling window limited to max 3 concurrent cohorts.
Maya: After each cohort I'll run these quick checks: 1) kv hitrate (>90%) 2) p95 latency under baseline 3) no pod crashloop in last 10m.
Ron: I'll post a short status after each cohort: OK / Degraded / Rollback and keep a watch in #eng-oncall.
Lia: I'll mute low-priority alerts and keep only Sev2/3+ forwarded.
Sasha: Thanks all. Posting a reminder 15m before start. If anyone needs an earlier or later window, shout now. :thumbsup:
